instruction: For an automatic development decomposition, select executionProfile {system:'nestos-work-delivery',id:<profile id>,revision:'1'} for EVERY subtask. Use source for development and integration: run relevant local checks, commit and integrate source without rebuilding or replacing the service. Create exactly ONE release subtask after ALL source tasks; it owns the single full build and service replacement. Add at least ONE verification subtask depending on release: independently verify the actual deployed version using its frozen deliveryEvidence; do not modify source, rebuild or deploy again. A verification failure blocks completion; repairs need a new explicit task. The parent only aggregates completion. Do not create a release per component. All source tasks must be ancestors of release and every verification must be a descendant of release. Keep task responsibilities small; platform delivery operations already perform build/deploy, so release task checks readiness and does not itself repeat these operations.
